<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Budget" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/budget-allocation">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetAllocation" name="Budget Allocation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline objectives">
      <bpmn:documentation>The department outlines its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft budget plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>The plan includes cost estimates and justifications for the requested budget.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ensures the plan aligns with broader organizational goals.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewMerge" name="Merge review round">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoopBack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Perform detailed finance review">
      <bpmn:documentation>The finance department assesses the budget's feasibility.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" name="Adjustments required?" default="Flow_NoAdjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Adjust</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdjustPlan" name="Adjust plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>Adjustments based on feedback from the reviews.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Adjust</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Approve adjustment">
      <bpmn:documentation>Approved by the necessary stakeholders.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoopBack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Implementation" name="Budget distributed, department begins implementation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_StrategicAlignmentReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Adjust" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_AdjustPlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${adjustmentRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AdjustPlan" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoopBack" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="EndEvent_Implementation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
